create_descriptor_pool: create a DescriptorPool instance to dynamically construct protobuf message types at runtime
add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorPool using the Add method
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name using FindMessageTypeByName
find_extension_by_number: find an extension field descriptor by its containing message and field number using FindExtensionByNumber
get_default_pool: get the default DescriptorPool singleton using the Default function
